text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp failing for some customers. Root cause looks like SDK missing an admin route that the quickstart uses. Getting 404 from sdk.admin.listRoutes(), but curl against the REST endpoint returns 200.
noah: ugh. Which route exactly?
maria: the sampleapp calls `sdk.admin.listRoutes({team: 'default'})`. Error: "404: route_not_found". When I curl `GET /v1/admin/routes?team=default` it returns payload.
alex: can you paste the exact error/log snippet?
maria: sure:
```
Error: 404: route_not_found
 at Admin.listRoutes (/node_modules/redwood-sdk/index.js:345)
 at Object.<anonymous> (sampleapp/onboard.js:22:15)
```
sam: quick thought — could be param name drift. SDK might expect `team_id` or `group` instead of `team`.
maria: tried `team_id` and `group` too, same 404. Also tried direct SDK call with explicit `path: '/admin/routes'` trick (we use that in other places) and it still 404s.
noah: is auth different? REST returns 200 when using the onboarding bearer token. Maybe SDK strips an auth header or uses ephemeral header.
maria: I logged the outgoing request from SDK — Authorization header present and matches curl. Body/params look right. The only difference is SDK sends `X-Client-Version: redwood-sdk/1.9.0`. REST works with curl that has no extra headers.
alex: hmm. Could be server-side routing that rejects due to user-agent header? unlikely. Another angle: SDK might be routing to a different base path (private vs hosted) depending on config. Are you on hosted?
maria: repro on hosted and local dev. Sampleapp config is default.
ci-bot: Automated test failure reported: `sdk-admin-list-routes` flaked in CI for commit abc123 (see: https://ci.internal/runs/9876) :warning:
noah: I can reproduce locally. Opening a minimal repro.
noah: repro code:
```js
const Redwood = require('redwood-sdk');
const sdk = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await sdk.admin.listRoutes({team: 'default'}); // -> 404
```
noah: quick hack: calling `sdk.request('GET','/v1/admin/routes',{team:'default'})` returns 200. So the lower-level request layer is fine. The problem is the typed wrapper `admin.listRoutes` mapping to the wrong path.
sam: that matches 'parameter drift' pattern — we recently refactored admin bindings in SDK v1.9.0 to consolidate endpoints and might have renamed the binding.
maria: ok can we patch sampleapp to use the lower-level request for now and add an integration test to catch this?
alex: yes. I'll draft a tiny fix in the sampleapp PR and add a unit test that calls the high-level admin wrapper in CI against staging.
noah: assigning to eng-sdks. I'll open an issue and link to the sampleapp PR.
maria: created issue RDW-4582 with repro and logs. PR for sampleapp using low-level request: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 (WIP).
sam: for long term, we should add a tiny e2e matrix that verifies all public admin bindings map to the expected REST routes. Could auto-derive expected paths from the openapi spec.
alex: agreed. Also add a changelog note for SDK v1.9.0 about binding renames.
noah: I'll add a quick lint rule in the codegen that fails if a binding's path doesn't match the OpenAPI path. That should prevent silent drifts.
maria: sweet. For now, patch + test + issue will unblock onboarding. @sam please follow up with a release candidate for the SDK v1.9.1 patch. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Job queued: `sdk-release-candidate` (build 202) — tagging PRs mentioned.
noah: leaving a note: also saw slightly different retry behavior — SDK retries on 5xx once, REST client used in sampleapp had no retry. For certain transient errors we saw duplicated requests. I'll log that separately.
maria: filed RDW-4583 for retry-behavior observation.
alex: thanks all. small follow-ups: add regression test + fix in SDK + backport to 1.8.x for critical customers.
maria: agreed. I'll update the onboarding docs to mention the temporary workaround (call `sdk.request` directly) until patch lands.
sam: ETA for patch? 1 business day.
maria: great — thanks everyone.
